description: This is a Python source file implementing analysis tools for Robot Framework test schemas, including extracting required variables from .robot files, parsing the Robot Framework model, analyzing keywords, variables, and test cases.

methods.name: str _normalize_var(name: str)
methods.description: Normalizes a variable name to a canonical form, stripping whitespace.

methods.name: Set[str] _extract_vars_from_text(text: str)
methods.description: Extracts variable references from text using regex, returning a set of variable names.

methods.name: bool _is_assignment_token(token_val: str)
methods.description: Checks if a token represents a variable assignment like '${var}='.

methods.name: Set[str] _assigned_vars(keyword_node)
methods.description: Extracts variables that are assigned within a keyword definition in the robot model.

methods.name: Set[str] _extract_file_level_variables(model)
methods.description: Extracts variables defined in the Variables section of the robot model.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_keyword_map(model)
methods.description: Builds a mapping from keyword names to their definitions for quick lookup.

methods.name: Optional[str] _find_best_keyword_match(call_name: str, kw_map: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Finds the best matching keyword definition for a call, prioritizing exact, prefix, then substring matches.

methods.name: Set[str] _process_keywords( testcase_node, kw_map: Dict[str, Any], visited: Set[str], assigned_in_visited_keywords: Set[str] )
methods.description: Recursively processes keywords in a test case to determine which variables are used, tracking assigned variables to avoid false positives.

methods.name: Set[str] _cleanup_candidates(vars_set: Set[str], assigned_in_visited: Set[str], file_level_vars: Set[str])
methods.description: Removes system, built-in, file-level, and assigned variables from candidate list to identify truly required variables.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_required_variables_for_case(content: str, case_name: str, test_id: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Main public function to analyze a robot test file content and extract required variables for a specific test case.
